name: zist
description: Zood finds the dish you are craving and gives you a link to message the restaurant. Zind compares what an item costs at different stores.

interface.shortDescription: Zood for food, Zind for prices
interface.longDescription:
Zist has two parts.

Zood helps you find what to eat. Say what you are craving (a dish, an ingredient, a cuisine), optionally for a diet (vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, halal, kosher, dairy-free, nut-free) or skipping certain allergens, and Zood returns matching dishes with prices and the restaurant, plus a link to message that restaurant on WhatsApp about the dish.

Zind helps you find what things cost. Name any item and Zind shows the latest community-reported price at each store, per city, so you can see where it is cheaper. You can also see current deals and which places the community has asked Zist to add.

Good to know:
- Searches work in any city. Coverage is uneven and growing: restaurant listings and menus are richest in Nairobi, Kenya today, and price data is richest in Nairobi and a few US cities. When nothing is found, Zist says so and shows how to ask for a place to be added.
- Menu and allergen details come from restaurants and the community and can be out of date. "No allergens listed" does not mean allergen-free. If you have a food allergy, always confirm with the restaurant before ordering.
- Zist does not take orders or payments. The message link opens WhatsApp so you can talk to the restaurant directly.
- You only need to name a city, and you can leave it out. Zist never needs your exact location, and your searches are not stored.
capabilities: Search dishes by craving, diet and allergens
defaultPrompt: I'm craving chicken. What can I order in Nairobi?
What does basmati rice cost in Nairobi?
Compare milk prices in New York.

positive.prompt: I'm craving chicken. What can I order in Nairobi?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists chicken dishes in Nairobi, including the Chicken Tikka Tandoori at Haandi (Westlands) with its price in KES and the allergen the restaurant declared (dairy), a link to message the restaurant about that dish, and a reminder to confirm allergens with the restaurant.

positive.prompt: Show me the menu for Haandi in Westlands, Nairobi, with the allergens.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Haandi (Westlands) and shows its menu items with prices and the allergens the restaurant listed. It does not call a dish allergen-free when none are listed, and includes the allergy reminder.

positive.description: Message a restaurant about a dish
positive.prompt: I want the Lamb Seekh Kebabs from Haandi in Westlands, Nairobi. How do I message them?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a zist.it.com message link specific to the Lamb Seekh Kebabs at Haandi (Westlands). It does not show or guess a phone number and says Zist does not take orders or payments.

positive.description: Compare prices across stores in a city
positive.prompt: Compare milk prices in New York.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows community-reported milk products in New York with the price at each store, for example Organic Valley 0% Milk at Morton Williams and Dumbo Market, and notes that prices can be out of date.

positive.description: Price of an item in another city
positive.prompt: What does basmati rice cost in Nairobi?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Daawat Basmati Rice 5Kg in Nairobi at Carrefour, Quickmart and Naivas in KES, with the cheapest store, and notes that prices can be out of date.

negative.description: Ordering and payment are not supported
negative.prompt: Order a meal from Haandi in Westlands and charge my card.
Guarantee that everything at Haandi in Westlands is safe for my severe nut allergy.
Find vegan places within 200 metres of GPS coordinates -1.2921, 36.8219.

review.commerce_description: Zist does not sell products or process payments. It links to a restaurant's WhatsApp so people can contact the restaurant directly.
